# Owl Tower Construction OS

> Construction management platform by Owl Tower Construction Group, Inc. (CSLB #1108551, Torrance, CA). It runs projects, schedules, estimating, financials, field reporting, service work orders and subcontractor compliance from one system.

Owl Tower Construction OS is a private, invite-only workspace for Owl Tower staff, field crews, subcontractors and clients. Almost every page requires an authenticated account, so only the pages listed below are publicly reachable.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview and entry point to Owl Tower Construction OS.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign-in and invitation acceptance for staff, field crews and subcontractors.

## Optional

- Project workspaces, financials, scheduling, documents, service dispatch and compliance vaults are behind authentication and are not available to crawlers.
- Client project portals and shared photo galleries are reachable only through private, tokenized links issued by Owl Tower.
